note: The script asks for two graphics: the hook text and the name super. Every other row is captions only, and the logo or name is only on the end card.

mg.title: Name super

mg.use: Name super from 00:07 to 00:09. Move it lower left, above the captions. Type the second line Dream Center Dallas under it.

mg.title: End card

mg.src: Dream Center Dallas has not sent its logo yet; the name is typed until Nick sends it, as the script says.
